note: The lab's generic redaction rules: what no public RFC or study may carry, for any lab. Each rule is a regular expression over one line, with [REDACTED: reason] markers reduced to their reasons. Patterns stay in the subset JavaScript and Rust's regex crate read the same way: no lookaround, no backreferences. A lab adds its own domains, words and patterns in its redaction.json. Served at docs.inorbit.hr/lab/rules.json for iohr lab check; the cases in conformance/ pin the behaviour.

rules.why: a path into the machine or the deployment
